【原视频简介】
HIGH PROTEIN Recipes That Actually Taste GOOD?! 😍 *PART 2*

Trying some more high protein recipes in today’s video! 💪🏻🥗 This is Part 2 of my High Protein Recipes series, where I try easy, healthy and protein-rich recipes and share my honest review of each one.

In this video, I tried:
✨ Idli Shakshuka
🥤 Protein Sattu Shake
🍎 Apple Greek Yogurt Smoothie
🍝 High Protein Pasta

I’ve shared the recipes, ingredients, preparation and my honest review/taste test for everything I made. Some were surprisingly good, while others definitely need a little tweaking! 😂

If you’re looking for easy high protein recipes, healthy vegetarian recipes, protein-rich breakfast ideas, healthy snacks or simple recipes for a healthier lifestyle, I hope this video gives you some ideas to try!

And PLEASE tell me your favourite healthy & high protein recipes in the comments! 👇🏻 I want to try your suggestions and hopefully bring PART 3 of this series very soon. ❤️

Don’t forget to LIKE, COMMENT & SUBSCRIBE to Shivani Duggal for more healthy recipes, lifestyle videos, vlogs and realistic wellness content! 🌻
